title: No-Spend Day Streak
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nospend:day
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(spent) as spent by _time
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(spent=0,1,0))) as streak reset_after="(spent>0)"
| sort - _time
description: Counts your current run of days with zero discretionary spending, gamifying mindful saving.
value: A no-spend streak makes frugality a game you want to win rather than a restriction you resent.
implementation: Flag zero-spend days in `index=personal`; schedule daily and surface the current streak.
visualization: Single-value tile of the current no-spend-day streak.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many days in a row you spent nothing extra, making saving feel like a game.
